entries.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: horizontal 3:2 editorial illustration for an evolution game's field diary. A small family of fictional shrew-like mammals with diverse sizes and tan, brown and olive coats arriving on driftwood at a new black volcanic shore, a second island across teal ocean. Clear story of animals carrying existing diversity across the sea. Style: refined nineteenth-century naturalist gouache and oil study with subtle paper grain, painterly realism, the portal's muted forest green, ochre gold, stone brown and teal palette. Rich atmospheric light, coherent anatomy, compelling readable focal subject even at small width. Full-bleed landscape composition. No lettering, labels, logos, border, UI or watermark. All mammals are deliberately fictional, not claimed native Galapagos fauna.
